text: {"verdict":"denied","governing_rule":"R3","reason":"The member's coverage under Meridian HMO Core became effective 07/15/2026, and the plan imposes a 90-day waiting period before benefits are available. The requested date of service, 08/14/2026, falls only 30 days into the coverage period, well before the 90-day waiting period elapses (which would end 10/13/2026). Because the waiting period had not been satisfied on the date of service, the total knee arthroplasty cannot be authorized regardless of the clinical documentation supporting medical necessity.","missing_information":[]}
